meta.source: RantAI Agents logo (light/dark SVG from RantAI-dev/rantai-page), product brief v1, rantai-page globals.css (Geist, feature palette)

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: App ground: the chat column, page bodies, admin content area.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text and icons on background, card, popover, sidebar, muted, accent, canvas (≥14:1 light, ≥12:1 dark).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, the composer, settings panels. Set apart from background by border in light, by shade in dark.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card. Alias of foreground (shadcn slot).

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, pickers, command palette, tooltips' ground, dialog surface.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover. Alias of foreground.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Left navigation rail and settings sub-nav ground.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Nav labels on sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hovered and current nav item fill on sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Nav label on sidebar-accent.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Hairline between sidebar and main area.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Active project dot / active indicator in the sidebar. Alias of primary.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-primary.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the sidebar. Alias of ring.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: user message bubble, code blocks, skeletons, table header, read-only fields.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, help text, placeholders, 'Answered by'. ≥4.5:1 on background, card, sidebar, muted, accent in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ghost buttons, menu items, table rows.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Artifact canvas and Studio backdrop behind the rendered page/slide.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers, card and panel outlines. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Boundary of text fields, selects, checkboxes, switches (off). ≥3:1 on background and card in both themes.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset in the ground colour. ≥5:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand blue (brief). One primary action per view, links, selection, comment pins, progress fill. Rebrandable: never hard-code.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text/icons on primary and primary-hover. Dark theme uses dark ink: white on #00a6f4 fails AA.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover/pressed fill.

tokens.name: primary-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected row, active version chip, current agent in picker, comment-target highlight fill.

tokens.name: primary-subtle-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-subtle (≥7:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and the 'switch' / 'Undo' text actions on background, card, muted.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete/revoke buttons, error text and icons on background and card.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on destructive.

tokens.name: destructive-subtle
tokens.usage: Error banner and 'Denied' cell fill.

tokens.name: destructive-subtle-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on destructive-subtle.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success icon/text, 'Allowed' marks, completed job state.

tokens.name: success-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on success.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: 'Allowed' cell and success banner fill.

tokens.name: success-subtle-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on success-subtle.

tokens.usage: Low-credit meter, policy notices, icons and text on background and card.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Out-of-credits inline notice, 'Disabled by admin policy' note fill.

tokens.name: warning-subtle-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on warning-subtle.

tokens.usage: Plan badge fill (Pro, Team, Enterprise) and 'Upgrade' chips. Logo navy in light, logo sky in dark.

tokens.name: plan-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on plan (≥8:1).

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: The mark's bubble and bar, exactly as the logo files: navy on light grounds, white on dark.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Logo navy. Marketing/cover blocks and the plan badge in light theme; not a UI surface.

spacing.note: 4px base grid. Dense UI (sidebar, tables, toolbars) uses 1–3; chat and dialogs 4–6; page gutters 6–10.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-badge nudge, hairline insets.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between icon and label in small controls.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label in buttons; sidebar item vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Sidebar item horizontal padding; gap between toolbar buttons; menu item padding.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Composer inner padding; table cell padding; card padding (dense).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between messages' meta and body; dialog field spacing.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog padding (mobile).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; gap between chat turns; page gutter on tablet.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing in settings and admin pages; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top padding of page headers.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: First-run hero offset; pricing section spacing.

radius.note: Base --radius is 0.75rem (brief). Steps mirror shadcn: sm = radius−4px, md = radius−2px, xl = radius+4px.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The base (shadcn --radius). Rebrand by changing this one value.

tokens.name: radius-lg

tokens.name: radius-xl

tokens.name: radius-2xl

tokens.name: radius-full

shadow.note: Borders carry structure; shadows only lift things that float (menus, dialogs, the composer, toasts).

tokens.name: shadow-sm

tokens.name: shadow-lg

tokens.usage: Hover/press colour changes; reduced-motion fallback.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Menus and tooltips in, chip toggles, 'Answered by' label swap.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Dialogs, comment pin drop, toasts, message fade-in.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Canvas open/close, sheet slide (or spring, see README).

tokens.name: duration-slower
tokens.usage: Fullscreen canvas, studio transition.

tokens.usage: Elements appearing (menus, toasts, pins).

tokens.name: ease-exit
